allocations.candidate_mechanism: A separate Burdettie supervisor starts unprivileged workers behind a pre-initialization barrier; waitpid and signals report lifecycle. Reuse PureDarwin launchd to start the supervisor.

source_refs.observation: ProcessInfo exposes only PID and main-thread identity; it is not a worker supervisor.
Builds a launchd PID-1 candidate; this is not Burdettie per-app supervision.

gaps: No integrated Burdettie managed-worker service or pre-initialization barrier on this guest.
Process groups alone do not prove control of daemonized or reparented descendants.
qualification_tests: A rejected launch cannot run a constructor marker.
Crash, cancel and timeout terminate and reap all descendants while the supervisor stays usable.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Supervisor timers and bounded output pipes for wall time/output; separately qualify guest kernel mechanisms for aggregate process-tree memory and process counts.

source_refs.observation: shim_setrlimit forwards to libc; no per-launch process-tree policy is established.

gaps: No qualified guest process-tree memory/count mechanism.
Host cgroup limits around QEMU protect the experiment and do not enforce guest per-app limits.
qualification_tests: Forking cannot multiply the permitted memory/process budget; inherited limits cannot be raised.
Audit reports would-limit while a distinct operational ceiling remains labelled operational.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Evaluate PureDarwin libsandbox native profiles and Sandbox.kext vnode hooks. Add a supervisor grant resolver only if object identity, aliases and handle semantics can satisfy the contract.

source_refs.observation: Native profile vnode hooks exist; decisions use paths and last matching rule. Apple compiled profiles are permissive markers.
Filesystem provider calls std::fs without owner-grant confinement.
Compatibility sandbox calls return success without enforcing restrictions.

gaps: No translation from owner object/tree grants to native profiles and no verified establishment.
Path matching alone does not qualify object grants, hard links, rename races or inherited descriptors.
The contract requires deny precedence; the candidate rule ordering needs an explicit translation and tests.
qualification_tests: Direct open/read/write/create and mmap bypassing shims are denied outside grants.
Test symlink, hard-link, rename, pre-opened descriptor and descendant paths; owner-granted access succeeds after relaunch.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Evaluate native PureDarwin Sandbox.kext socket hooks for the v1 deny policy; allow_all is a visible policy choice.

source_refs.observation: Registers socket bind/connect checks; source inspection does not prove coverage of sendto, inherited connected sockets or other families.
shim_connect permits destinations through libc; unsupported-family errors are compatibility behavior.

gaps: No qualified deny-all backend; bind/connect hook presence is insufficient.
The offline VM profile restricts the entire guest environment and cannot establish per-app network isolation.
qualification_tests: Direct IPv4, IPv6, UDP sendto, inherited sockets and descendant connections obey the selected policy.
Audit records would-deny without applying the optional restriction; missing observation is incomplete.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Combine immutable reviewed executable admission with native profile inheritance and guest exec controls, then close process creation and privilege-change gaps.

source_refs.observation: Credential-label association and process-exec checks are candidate pieces, not full child authorization.
posix_spawn and posix_spawnp call host libc without supervisor-issued child plans.

gaps: No complete fork/exec/posix_spawn/daemonization admission path.
A path-based exec rule does not bind reviewed executable digests.
qualification_tests: Denied children create no marker; reviewed child bytes execute only with equal or narrower policy.
Double-fork, setsid, direct exec and credential changes cannot escape restrictions or lifecycle ownership.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Qualify guest kernel task/debug access checks plus unprivileged identities; do not implement denial only in task or ptrace shims.

source_refs.observation: Inspected operation table does not allocate a complete process-inspection policy.

gaps: No per-app denial for task ports, debugger operations and process-control interfaces.
qualification_tests: Direct task-port, ptrace and process-memory access to the supervisor or another app is denied, including from descendants.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Admitted immutable code mappings need an explicit execution path; qualify a guest kernel rule that rejects runtime-generated executable mappings and protection changes.

source_refs.observation: Mapping/protection services support runtime execution, not a per-app JIT prohibition.
Inspected policy table is not evidence of mmap/mprotect JIT restriction.

gaps: No qualified distinction between admitted mapped code and newly generated executable memory.
qualification_tests: Direct mmap/mprotect and native FFI cannot create executable writable or generated code under deny; admitted fixture code still runs.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Use per-worker service namespaces and authenticated brokers only where guest kernel/IPC rights also prevent direct access to non-granted services.

source_refs.observation: Compatibility XPC transport exists; it is not an owner-grant service namespace.

gaps: No qualified Mach-port, Unix-socket or handle-transfer isolation for service allowlists.
qualification_tests: Direct IPC and transferred/inherited handles cannot reach an ungranted supervisor or peer service; granted services work.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Resolve explicit owner device grants through a broker and qualify guest device-node and IOKit access denial for all other devices.

source_refs.observation: IOKit compatibility entry points do not establish a guest kernel device boundary.

gaps: No owner-issued device-grant broker or complete direct device restriction.
qualification_tests: Direct device-node open, ioctl and IOKit user-client access are denied unless an exact reviewed grant permits them.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Extend shared runtime admission to immutable initial/transitive/inserted/dynamic dependencies and the exact allowed shim/native provider set before initialization.

source_refs.observation: Loader is an integration point; its existence does not qualify full dependency policy.
Legacy admission evaluator is distinct from the M1 supervisor contract.

gaps: PR #5 advances admission route parity but is unmerged and does not qualify the PureDarwin backend.
Later dynamic loads, native fallback and cached plans still need identity-bound provider/dependency admission.
qualification_tests: Denied transitive, inserted and dlopen libraries never run constructors; cached plans are revalidated for the effective profile.
Replacing a provider or dependency after inventory cannot execute substituted bytes.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Bind inventory and policy to pinned open objects or a verified immutable content store used by mapping/execution.

source_refs.observation: Runtime loader paths need immutable content identity across parse, admission, cache and execution.
Inventory hashes are passive observations, not immutable execution handles.

gaps: No supervisor-issued identity and immutable executable/dependency store qualified on the guest.
qualification_tests: Swap an executable/dependency after inventory and before initialization; unreviewed bytes cannot execute or inherit grants.
An app copying another bundle identifier or report cannot gain that app's grants.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Use a maintained cryptographic implementation to validate content hashes, CodeDirectory/CMS binding, code-signing chain usage, time and configured revocation behavior.

source_refs.observation: Signature model explicitly checks presence rather than CMS/page integrity.
verify_cms_signature ignores CodeDirectory data and returns signature_verified=false; a root fingerprint in a certificate bag is not a verified chain.

gaps: No complete authenticated executable/bundle/signature verifier integrated with immutable launch inputs.
Unsigned permission is an independent profile choice and cannot be treated as a confinement downgrade.
qualification_tests: Tampered code, special slots, resources and entitlements fail the selected integrity requirement.
An unrelated trusted root placed in a fake CMS cannot qualify a signer; time/revocation/offline outcomes follow the exact profile.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Bind entitlement bytes to verified content, evaluate presence-based v1 deny/request-only rules and finalize aggregate admission after all checks.

source_refs.observation: Parsed entitlement evaluation exists; source baseline precedes the final-aggregation correction in PR #5.

gaps: PR #5 fixes aggregate denial behavior but is unmerged; no selected-guest qualification.
Guest entitlements must never mint owner grants or override the profile.
qualification_tests: A final denied entitlement prevents all initializers through every route.
Modified entitlement bytes invalidate integrity; request-only and unknown keys obey their explicit rules.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Supervisor constructs explicit argument/environment data and passes a launch-bound context; policy transformations happen only in enforced mode.

source_refs.observation: Legacy configuration has environment overrides and optional security policy; it is not the versioned owner mode/profile API.

gaps: No complete owner-resolved permissive/audit/enforced environment path across all launch adapters.
qualification_tests: Audit records would-strip without stripping; permissive skipped checks are not verified.
Workers and descendants receive no ambient secret environment, and reports contain names rather than values.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Supervisor-owned versioned policy/grant store with atomic writes, stable identities and guest-inaccessible ownership; apply edits on relaunch.

source_refs.observation: Policy builders construct runtime values; they do not establish a protected owner policy service.

gaps: No durable owner-controlled store, authorization layer or rollback/recovery qualification.
qualification_tests: A guest cannot edit profiles, grants, trust anchors or report history; legitimate owner changes survive a cold reboot.
Interrupted writes preserve a recoverable policy and never default to permissive.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Authenticate owner/delegated callers at a supervisor endpoint using kernel-established peer identity and launch-scoped, non-replayable grants.

source_refs.observation: Compatibility get_euid/get_egid query the current process; they do not authenticate a remote request peer.
Defines owner authority and opaque grant references, not an implemented broker.

gaps: No authenticated supervisor registration/launch/grant broker.
App-provided identifiers, entitlement JSON and compatibility identity calls are not authorization.
qualification_tests: Forged/replayed grant references and calls from guest workers cannot change owner policy or launch with another app's authority.
Authorized owner requests remain usable in all three modes.

allocations.candidate_mechanism: Supervisor collects launch-bound decisions and protected lifecycle/denial events, with explicit coverage and mandatory-channel failure handling.

source_refs.observation: Runtime tracing provides diagnostics, not a protected complete policy event channel.
Kernel denial printf output is limited; sandbox_check compatibility answers do not report full enforcement decisions.

gaps: No authenticated durable event stream or complete guest direct-operation audit coverage.
Do not establish native sandbox restrictions just to obtain audit-mode events.
qualification_tests: Audit would-deny events agree with enforced denials without restricting optional operations.
Missing observation or failed required event delivery is visible; guests cannot rewrite reports or hide descendant events.

related_work.scope: Admission parity and entitlement aggregation; no PureDarwin confinement qualification.
